category_title: Socially isolated children with low self-confidence and resilience
minimal_context: Catriona is participating in an initial whole class philosophical inquiry session using the 'Laura and Paul' text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our whole class discussion on the 'Laura and Paul' text. Does anyone have a question or idea to start us off?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly next to her allocated buddy, listening attentively to the others but not volunteering any questions or ideas.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Catriona, what do you think about the story?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Um... I just think Laura is nice. My buddy is nice too.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you explain how that fits with what the rest of the class is discussing?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks down, refusing to take an active role in the whole class discussion, and turns to speak only to her buddy instead) I don't know... I don't want to say anything else.
